topic: Ordering Coffee at a Busy Café

script.title: AT THE BUSY CAFÉ
script.story_hook: The line is long, but the coffee is worth it.
script.intro_zh: 隊伍很長，但這杯咖啡值得等待。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to today's café scene. Listen for handy ordering phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到今天的咖啡館場景。留意實用的點單說法。
script.outro: And that's a café order done right. Listen again and try it out loud.
script.outro_zh: 一筆咖啡訂單就這樣完成。再聽一次，大聲跟著說說看。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a young woman in her mid twenties with dark brown hair in a loose low bun, round glasses, a mustard yellow hoodie, a canvas tote bag on one shoulder, and a slim build
script.char_b_description: a cheerful young man in his early twenties with short curly black hair, a thick beard, a forest green barista apron over a grey t-shirt, black cap backwards, and a stocky build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, sorry, is this the line for the counter?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ˈsɑɹi ɪz ðɪs ðə ˈlaɪn fɚ ðə ˈkaʊɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，不好意思，請問要在這邊排隊點餐嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, and it moves slower than you'd hope!
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ænd ɪt muːvz ˈsloʊɚ ðæn jʊd hoʊp/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，而且隊伍動得比你想像的還慢！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair enough, I've got time before my meeting.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɛɹ ɪˈnʌf aɪv ɡɑt taɪm bɪˈfɔɹ maɪ ˈmitɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 也對，開會前我還有點時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, what can I get started for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wʌt kən aɪ ɡɛt ˈstɑɹɾɪd fɚ ju/
dialogue.zh: 好，請問要先幫你做什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A large iced oat milk latte, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə lɑɹdʒ aɪst oʊt mɪk ˈlɑɾeɪ pliz/
dialogue.zh: 一杯大杯冰燕麥奶拿鐵，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coming up. Do you want shots with that?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʌmɪŋ ʌp du ju wɑnt ʃɑts wɪð ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。要再加濃縮咖啡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, two extra, but only on this one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm tu ɪkˈstɹoʊ bʌt ˈoʊnli ɑn ðɪs wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，多加兩份，但只加這一杯就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sweet. Any flavor? Vanilla's everybody's friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /swit ˈɛni ˈfleɪvɚ vəˈnɪləz ˈɛvɹiˌbɑdiz fɹɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 好的。要加風味糖漿嗎？香草最不容易出錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Actually, caramel if you have it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæktʃuəli ˈkɑɹməɪl ɪf ju hæv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 其實如果有焦糖糖漿的話，我要焦糖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do, but we're out of caramel syrup.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi du bʌt wɪɹ ˈaʊt əv ˈkɑɹməɪl ˈsɪɹəp/
dialogue.zh: 喔，焦糖糖漿剛好賣完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, that was my favorite part.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ ðæt wəz maɪ ˈfeɪvɚɪt pɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 噢不，那可是我最喜歡的部分耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know, it happened to me last week too.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ ɪt həˈpænd tə mi læst wik tu/
dialogue.zh: 我懂，上週我也遇到一樣的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, um, can I get it without flavor?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ʌm kən aɪ ɡɛt ɪt wɪˈðaʊt ˈfleɪvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那，嗯，可以什麼風味都不加嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, though it tastes pretty plain, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ ðoʊ ɪt ˈteɪsts ˈpɹɪti pleɪn ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 當然，不過老實說喝起來會很淡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's okay, I'll stir in a little sugar.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts oʊkeɪ aɫ stɚ ɪn ə ˈlɪɾɚ ˈʃʊɡɚ/
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，我自己攪一點糖進去就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart move. Can I take your name?
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt muv kən aɪ teɪk jɔɹ ˈneɪm/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。請問杯子上要寫的名字是？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's Wren, one syllable, easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ɹɛn wʌn ˈsɪləbl ˈizi/
dialogue.zh: 是 Wren，一個音節，很好唸。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, when?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑɹi wɛn/
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，剛剛說什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wren, like the little bird.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹɛn laɪk ðə ˈlɪɾɚ bɝd/
dialogue.zh: Wren，就是小小的那種鳥。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, Wren, spelled W-R-E-N.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt ɹɛn spɛld ˈdəbəlˈju ˌɑɹ ˌi ˌɛn/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，Wren，拼法是 W-R-E-N。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, most people write it wrong, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt moʊst ˈpipəl ɹaɪt ɪt ɹɔŋ hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，大部分人都會寫錯，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hey, I take pride in my spelling.
dialogue.phonetic: /heɪ aɪ teɪk pɹaɪd ɪn maɪ ˈspɛlɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 嘿，我的拼字可是值得自豪的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, fair. Can I also grab a blueberry muffin?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ fɛɹ kən aɪ ˈɔlsoʊ ɡɹæb ə ˈbluˌbɛɹi ˈmʌfɪn/
dialogue.zh: 哈，合理。我可以再買一個藍莓瑪芬嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the last one's right here under glass.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə læst wʌnz ɹaɪt hɪɹ ˈʌndɚ ɡlæs/
dialogue.zh: 有，最後一個就在這個玻璃櫃裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll take it. Is it warm or cold?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɫ teɪk ɪt ɪz ɪt wɔɹm ɔɹ koʊld/
dialogue.zh: 我要。它現在是溫的還是涼的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can zap it ten seconds for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kən zæp ɪt tɛn ˈsɛkəndz fɚ ju/
dialogue.zh: 我可以用微波爐幫你熱十秒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten seconds sounds great, thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈsɛkəndz ˈsaʊndz ɡɹeɪt θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 十秒聽起來很棒，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, nine fifty total. Card or cash?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ naɪn ˈfɪfti ˈtoʊɾəl kɑɹd ɔɹ kæʃ/
dialogue.zh: 總共九塊五。刷卡還是付現金？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Card, um, can I use my phone?
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑɹd ʌm kən aɪ juz maɪ foʊn/
dialogue.zh: 刷卡，嗯，我可以用手機付嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can, just hold it near the reader.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kən dʒʌst hoʊld ɪt nɪɹ ðə ˈɹidɚ/
dialogue.zh: 可以，把手機靠近感應區就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, did it beep? I don't hear a beep.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm dɪd ɪt bip aɪ doʊnt hɪɹ ə bip/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，它有嗶一聲嗎？我沒聽到聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One more try, hold it a bit higher.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔɹ tɹaɪ hoʊld ɪt ə bɪt ˈhaɪɚ/
dialogue.zh: 再試一次，拿高一點看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There we go, it finally likes me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹ wi ɡoʊ ɪt ˈfaɪnəli laɪks mi/
dialogue.zh: 好了，它終於願意理我了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's shy with new phones. Receipt in the app?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ʃaɪ wɪð nju foʊnz ɹɪˈsit ɪn ðæp/
dialogue.zh: 它對新手機有點害羞。收據要用 App 傳嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, email me the receipt, no paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈimeɪl mi ðə ɹɪˈsit noʊ ˈpeɪpɚ/
dialogue.zh: 好，用電子郵件傳收據就好，不用紙本。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Number forty-two on the cup, watch the bar.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌmbɚ ˈfoɹti tu ɑn ðə kʌp wɑtʃ ðə bɑɹ/
dialogue.zh: 杯子上會標四十二號，請看著出杯台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty-two, got it. How long will it be?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfoɹti tu ɡɑɾ ɪt haʊ lɔŋ wɪl ɪt bi/
dialogue.zh: 四十二號，記下了。要等多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six minutes, we're slammed this morning, sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈmɪnɪts wɪɹ slæmd ðɪs ˈmɔɹnɪŋ ˈsɑɹi/
dialogue.zh: 六分鐘，早上忙翻了，不好意思。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No worries, my meeting got pushed anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwɝɪz maɪ ˈmitɪŋ ɡɑt pʊʃt ˈɛniˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 別在意，我的會議剛好也延後了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lucky you. Forty-two for Wren, latte's up!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlʌki ju ˈfoɹti tu fɚ ɹɛn ˈlɑteɪz ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 你真幸運。四十二號 Wren，拿鐵好了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's me! Um, this cup says Renny.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts mi ʌm ðɪs kʌp sɛz ˈɹɛni/
dialogue.zh: 是我！嗯，可是這個杯子寫的是 Renny。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, the other guy calls names from memory.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ ði ˈʌðɚ ɡaɪ kɑlz neɪmz fɹəm ˈmɛməɹi/
dialogue.zh: 噢不，另一位夥伴都是憑記憶喊名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He added a whole extra name to mine.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi əˈdæd ə hoʊl ˈɛkstɹə neɪm tə maɪn/
dialogue.zh: 他幫我的名字多添了一整個字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll fix it right now, don't pay that guy.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɫ fɪks ɪt ɹaɪt naʊ doʊnt peɪ ðæt ɡaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我馬上幫你重做，錢別付給他喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Haha, it's fine, the drink looks okay.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɑhɑ ɪts faɪn ðə dɹɪŋk lʊks oʊkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，沒關係，這杯飲料看起來還不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Still, wrong names bug us baristas all day.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪl ɹɔŋ neɪmz bʌɡ ʌs bəˈɹɪstəz ɔl deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 話雖如此，寫錯名字會讓咖啡師整天困擾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair point. Can I get a napkin too?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ pɔɪnt kən aɪ ɡɛt ə ˈnæpkɪn tu/
dialogue.zh: 說得也是。可以再給我一張紙巾嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, and here's a lid, just in case.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔɹs ænd hɪɹz ə lɪd dʒʌst ɪn keɪs/
dialogue.zh: 當然，再給你一個杯蓋，以防灑出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're a hero. Is the muffin warm now?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹz ə ˈhɪɹoʊ ɪz ðə ˈmʌfɪn wɔɹm naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 你真是救星。瑪芬現在是溫的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm as sunshine, careful, the inside's hot.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔɹm æz ˈsʌnˌʃaɪn ˈkɛɹfəl ði ɪnˈsaɪdz hɑt/
dialogue.zh: 暖得像陽光，小心，裡面很燙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Can I also get a cup of water?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt kən aɪ ˈɔlsoʊ ɡɛt ə kʌp əv ˈwɔɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我可以再要一杯水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free water's right there, help yourself.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɹi ˈwɔɾɚz ɹaɪt ðɛɹ hɛlp jɔɹˈsɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 免費的水就在那邊，請自己拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, I think that's everything on my list.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt aɪ θɪŋk ðæts ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ ɑn maɪ lɪst/
dialogue.zh: 好，我想清單上的東西都齊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next time, just say your name twice, it helps.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst taɪm dʒʌst seɪ jɔɹ ˈneɪm twaɪs ɪt hɛlps/
dialogue.zh: 下次你的名字多說兩遍，會幫助很大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Haha, I'll say it like a little spell.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɑhɑ aɫ seɪ ɪt laɪk ə ˈlɪɾɚ spɛl/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，我會像唸小魔咒一樣唸出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wren twice, done. Have a great meeting.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹɛn twaɪs dʌn hæv ə ɡɹeɪt ˈmitɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 唸兩遍 Wren，完美。開會順利。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for handling the chaos with a smile.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks fɚ ˈhændəlɪŋ ðə ˈkeɪˌɑs wɪð ə smaɪl/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你微笑著搞定這麼混亂的場面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime, enjoy the latte before the ice melts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌtaɪm ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ðə ˈlɑteɪ bɪˈfɔɹ ði aɪs mɛlts/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，趁冰還沒融化，好好享用拿鐵吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will. See you around, star barista.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl si ju əˈɹaʊnd stɑɹ bəˈɹɪstə/
dialogue.zh: 我會的。再見囉，王牌咖啡師。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye Wren, come back when it's quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ɹɛn kʌm bæk wɛn ɪts ˈkwaɪət/
dialogue.zh: 再見 Wren，等人少的時候再來。

script.youtube_title: 【超忙咖啡店☕】「它終於願意理我了」教你點一杯燕麥奶拿鐵🥛🎧｜聽完就能自己點單｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Ordering Coffee at a Busy Café
script.youtube_title_en: "It Finally Likes Me" — Ordering a Custom Latte at a Busy Café
script.youtube_description:
「它終於願意理我了」——在超忙的咖啡廳，怎麼把一杯客製化燕麥奶拿鐵完整點出來？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在最熱鬧的咖啡店櫃台前。

你會聽到：排隊開場、說清大小杯、冰塊、植物奶與加濃縮的完整點單句；焦糖糖漿賣完時怎麼換選項；留下名字卻聽錯、杯子寫錯名字時怎麼幽默處理；還有手機感應付款失敗、重新感應的實用說法。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與十分鐘內說得完的短句，反覆出現的是美國人每天在咖啡店用的真實語感：um、well、so、ha、fair enough。聽完你就會用：Can I get...、Coming up、I'll take it、No worries、Anytime。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴噹。
script.youtube_description_en:
"It finally likes me" — how do you order a fully custom oat milk latte at the busiest café in town? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set right at the counter.

You will hear: joining the long line, stating size, ice, milk choice and extra shots; swapping flavors when the caramel syrup is gone; the name-on-cup mix-up handled with humor; and the tap-to-pay reader that beeps... or doesn't.

Everything stays in A2-level words, with the small talk Americans actually use: um, well, so, ha, fair enough. By the end you'll own phrases like Can I get..., Coming up, I'll take it, and Anytime.

Chapter 4 is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
早上趕開會，咖啡廳的隊伍卻長到路邊，你還來得及把飲料點對嗎？名字到底該怎麼唸、怎麼拼，店員才會聽懂？感應付款一直不嗶，該怎麼辦？

這一集帶大家走進一家超忙的咖啡店，從排隊、客製化點單、改名替換糖漿，一路聽到出杯與道別，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
☕ 完整點單句：A large iced oat milk latte, please.
🥄 換選項：Well, um, can I get it without flavor?
💳 付款句：Card, um, can I use my phone?
🎧 出杯糾錯：Um, this cup says Renny.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、so 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。只要跟著這個繁忙的早晨走一趟，下次自己走進咖啡店，話就從嘴邊自己冒出來。

祝你今天也有一杯剛剛好的咖啡。
